QuestInfo.name: The Heliogene Device
QuestInfo.1: In order to stop him from making the bioweapon, you need to get the parts before Mr. Hazard's lackeys do. Find out their locations from #bConey#k.
QuestInfo.2: You know where to find the weapon parts.

0.msg: Cadena, the weapon parts are in the #bGarbage Dump#k, #bStray Dog Alley#k, and the #bPawn Shop#k. If that's all, I-I'll be leaving now.\r\n

1.msg: Radio me if anything else c-comes up. But... I hope nothing does.\r\n

2.msg: #b(The boss and Coney headed for the hideout. Now you need to find those weapon parts. Start by searching the far reaches of the Garbage Dump.)#k\r\n #r(You will automatically move to the relevant field.)#k

default.0: Before you leave, get the location of the weapon parts from Coney. Well, then... good luck!
